oynatma_listesi_aciklama: One popular food claim per episode, checked against the research.
kanal_aciklama:
The Food Almanac explains what the research actually says about everyday food questions: calmly, clearly and without hype.

Should you eat your vegetables first? Is breakfast really the most important meal? Do seed oils deserve their reputation? Each episode takes one popular food claim, walks through the studies behind it, explains the biology in plain language, and shows where the evidence is strong and where it runs out.

New videos every Tuesday and Friday.

Every video lists its sources in the description. Illustrations are AI-generated in the style of vintage science-book engravings, and narration uses a synthetic voice. Videos are for education only and are not medical advice: talk to your doctor before changing your diet or medication.
